files.transformation: Copied byte-for-byte as delivered: a 1254 x 1254 WebP. Gold and stone piles in a 2 x 2 grid on a flat magenta (#FF00FF) key background, cells left to right, top to bottom: small gold, large gold, small stone, large stone. Bundled with the desktop renderer and processed at run time (chroma key, one-pixel erosion, re-outline, per-cell crop, downscale) into the generated map icon's gold and stone layer.
